title: Sperm Counts Fell 52%—Then The Decline Accelerated
hook: Men now produce far fewer sperm, and the loss is speeding up.
closing: A faster decline could make starting a family harder for more people.
question: Why is the decline accelerating?

segments.say: Sperm concentration fell 52 percent. Modern samples contain about half as many sperm as older ones.
The annual sperm-count decline accelerated to 2.64 percent. The loss is now happening faster.
Total sperm count fell 62 percent. The decline affects overall production, not only concentration.
